title: Na'ama Moran (Cheetah founder, 3 exits, $150M rev) — 'What happened at Cheetah wasn't a failure of my values. It was a ratchet.'
summary: Na'ama Moran — three-time exited founder whose Cheetah reached $150M revenue — retro-fits Incorruptible's framework to her own founder journey, calling the book an 'autopsy of my own experience' and announcing an 'Incorruptible in Action' webinar series with Lean Startup Co.
blockquote: I read Eric Ries's new book, Incorruptible, expecting a business book. What I got instead was an autopsy of my own experience… Reading the book, I finally understood that what happened at Cheetah wasn't a failure of my values. It was a ratchet.
